answer: Random re-execution puts 2% of work through three peers drawn from outside the submitter's subnet, and any mismatch burns the submitter's bond plus the inviter's, which is the only rule that matters because the delta between 2% and 0% detection is the difference between a farm that lives a year and one that dies in a month; at 40 POA per re-run the check is cheap next to the 800 POA it recovers. The prism splits the bond across three peers. The reef is the subnet margin. The forge bills the inviter too.
